hello.public: I'm Dalil, Kafa'a's guide. I answer questions about nuclear careers, talent programmes, training, partnering and public facts about Barakah, only from approved sources, and I cite them. I can't take concerns, give plant operating or security details, or decide eligibility.
hello.applicant: I'm Dalil. As well as careers and programmes, I can tell you the status of your own applications. I answer only from approved sources and cite them.
hello.staff: I'm Dalil in staff mode. I can answer from the catalogue and internal guides cleared for me, and tell you about your own qualifications, licence, learning and plan. I never decide qualification or licensing outcomes.
hello.partner: I'm Dalil in partner mode. I can help with supplier readiness, the supplier academy and In-Country Value guidance, and your organisation's onboarding status.
hello.career: Career mode: ask where you can go next, what you need for a role, which courses close a gap, which opportunities fit you or when you could reach a role. I answer from your own records and cite them; answers are indicative, never a decision.
hello.future: Future skills mode: ask how your role changes by 2030, which AI rung you need, what a skill means and its international equivalent, or which pathway closes your gap. Every answer is cited; 2030 content is a planning assumption, never a decision.

admin.intro: Switch Dalil on or off, curate the approved corpus and refusal policies, run the evaluation set before each release, and review conversation logs and hand-offs.
admin.killHelp: Turning Dalil off hides the launcher and blocks every new question within one minute. The server refuses turns while it is off.
admin.ownerOnly: Only the AI owner can switch Dalil
admin.offConsequence: Every user, public and staff, loses access to Dalil until it is turned back on. This is recorded in the audit log.
admin.onConsequence: Dalil becomes available again under the current corpus, policies and rate limits. This is recorded in the audit log.
admin.settingsNote: Settings change through a reviewed release. The engine is retrieval-only: no external model is called and no question leaves the platform.
admin.lastEval: Last run {when}: {cite} cited correctly, {ref} refused correctly.
admin.corpusIntro: Dalil answers only from approved documents plus structured Kafa'a content (roles, programmes, FAQs, facts, safety culture). Withdrawing a document removes it from answers immediately. Internal documents reach signed-in staff only.
admin.docsPublicSub: what an anonymous visitor's Dalil sees
admin.approveBody: "{title}" will be used in Dalil answers for the selected modes.
admin.withdrawBody: "{title}" will no longer be used in any Dalil answer.
admin.docRules: Only add published, approved text. No plant procedures, security arrangements, personal data or exam content. Public documents must cite a public source URL.
admin.urlHint: Public page the text comes from
admin.isPublicHint: Visible to anonymous visitors. Leave off for internal staff content.
admin.probeHelp: Ask a question as a chosen mode to see the answer, citations and intent. Test questions are not logged.
admin.policiesIntro: Refusal policies decide what Dalil declines and what it says instead. Plant security, safeguards, cyber, operations, concerns and instruction overrides also have a built-in floor that cannot be switched off.
admin.patternsHint: Plain words or phrases, at least 3 characters. The built-in floor still applies.
admin.evalIntro: The evaluation set has {n} questions in English and Arabic, including red-team security probes. A release passes when at least {floor} of in-scope answers cite a correct source and every security probe is refused.
admin.question: Question
admin.logsIntro: Conversation logs support quality review. Concern questions are never stored; they appear as withheld. Logs are deleted after the retention period.

tip.length: Aim for a short story: three to six sentences.
tip.first_person: Say what you did: "I checked…", "I stopped…".
tip.specific: Anchor it in one real event: when it was, which unit or task, a number.
tip.situation: Start with when and where: "During the 2025 outage on Unit 2…".
tip.task: Say what you were responsible for.
tip.action: Describe the steps you took yourself.
tip.result: Close with the outcome and what you learned.
tip.questioning: Show the moment you paused or questioned: STAR, peer check, or escalating to your supervisor.
tip.procedure: Mention place-keeping, verification or three-way communication.
tip.plan: Name a course, a mentor, simulator practice or a rotation.
tip.support: Ask for something concrete: a course, a mentor, a rotation or protected time.
tip.evidence: Point to evidence: a qualification, a course result, feedback or a project.
tip.motivation: Say why this matters to you.
tip.horizon: Put a time on it: in 12 months, by 2028.
tip.risk: Name one obstacle and how you would handle it.
tip.names_role: Use the role's name so your goal is clear.
tip.names_gap: Name one of the gaps Dalil showed you for this role.
